about: Rocky View County is a municipal district wrapped around Calgary, covering hamlets, acreages, and farms rather than a city. Bragg Creek, Langdon, Harmony, Bearspaw, Springbank, and Balzac sit in the county; Cochrane, Airdrie, and Chestermere are separate municipalities carved out of the same countryside. CrossIron Mills and Glenbow Ranch sit on county land at Calgary’s edge. About 41,000 people live in Rocky View County.
seoSummary: Municipal district surrounding Calgary, a countryside of hamlets, acreages, and Bow River parks—not a city.
